purpose.summary: A stock price update program (STP033) that maintains stock price records in a multi-user environment. It manages concurrent access via a queue/lock mechanism using a PARAM file, writes recovery file records for rollback, and provides a screen-based interactive interface for updating stock prices.
purpose.domain: retail/inventory (stock price management, likely point-of-sale or wholesale/retail business system)

notable_features: COMP-5 (Micro Focus native binary) extensively used for subscripts and keys
SCREEN SECTION with color attributes (FOREGROUND-COLOR, BACKGROUND-COLOR)
Multi-user locking/queuing mechanism via PARAM file
Recovery file with transaction logging for rollback
Extensive use of COPY statements for modular file definitions and screen layouts
LINKAGE SECTION with chained program parameters (LS-PARID, LS-USER-ID, LS0-PROGRAMS, LS0-SECURITY)
ASCII box-drawing characters (X"B3", X"CD") for screen borders
GPL license header embedded in SECURITY paragraph
verdict.notes: File is truncated at 16000 chars out of 32583 bytes; the full procedure division is not visible but the visible portion shows a well-structured production system. The program is part of a larger APAC business suite by J.W. Lemmon, version 8.13.07 (March 2008). The 'online-cics' program_type label is used loosely here — this is actually a Micro Focus screen-based interactive batch/online program, not CICS. No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL present. The COPY statements reference many external copybooks (APACFIDS, CONTROL, DEPART, PARAM, RECOVER, SHARED, STOCK, STKPRC, etc.) that are not included in this file.
